description: This file defines the HomeShell widget, a StatefulWidget that manages the main navigation for the fitness mobile app. It sets up a bottom navigation bar with four tabs (Dashboard, Workouts, Goals, Profile) and displays the corresponding pages using an IndexedStack.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the main shell of the app, providing bottom navigation between different feature tabs.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class managing navigation index and page rendering for HomeShell.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeShell.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loads initial app data asynchronously.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeShell, including the gradient background, scaffold, indexed stack, and bottom navigation bar.
